study_note: Fresh seed-55 Dog Run BOOM run. Add corrected BOOM sampled-action alignment with coefficient 0.00038 = 0.01 * (38/1000), std floor 0.05 and compiled outer loss. Preserve the existing dog post-tanh baseline: fixed joint entropy 0.0021, H3/J8/K1, N128/C16/A4/B256, sampled execution, 1M decisions, action repeat 2 with summed rewards, 500-decision episodes, all checkpoints every 25k and critic geometry every 1k outer updates. Evaluation campaigns are separate.
